fact: As presented by the DGI director-general at the AfDB annual meetings (26-30 May 2025), e-impôts offers tele-declaration and telepayment, DGI Mobile pays taxes by phone, and individuals can pay land tax by mobile money.
title: Digitalisation Fiscale : La Côte D'Ivoire Partage Son Expertise Aux Assemblées Annuelles De La BAD
